def equation(x: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a fractionally-damped nonlinear oscillator
    
    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.

        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized
    
    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    k_linear = params[0]  # Linear spring constant
    k_nonlinear = params[1]  # Nonlinear spring constant
    b = params[2]  # Linear damping coefficient
    b_fractional = params[3]  # Fractional damping exponent
    d = params[4]  # Linear driving force
    e = params[5]  # Nonlinear driving force
    x_0 = params[6]  # Center of energy well
    k_fractional = params[7]  # Fractional driving force exponent
    h = params[8]  # Phase shift of the driving force
    n = params[9]  # Hysteretic damping coefficient
    p = params[10]  # Phase shift of the hysteretic damping
    m = params[11]  # Amplitude of the hysteretic damping
    m_fractional = params[12]  # Fractional amplitude of the hysteretic damping
    w = params[13]  # Frequency of driving or hysteretic damping term
